package com.synexia.common.collections;

import com.m3.collections.M3FilteredViews;
import com.m3.collections.M3MutableFilteredViews;

import com.synexia.common.collections.jdk.FilteredViews;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.NavigableSet;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.TreeSet;
import java.util.function.Predicate;

/** Independent failing baseline cases, retained outside positive qualification gates. */
public final class M3WrapperNavigationCounterexample {
    private M3WrapperNavigationCounterexample() { }

    public static void main(String[] arguments) {
        String id = arguments.length == 0 ? "m3-null-ceiling" : arguments[0];
        boolean bounded = id.startsWith("mutable-range-");
        boolean reverse = id.endsWith("-reverse");
        NavigableSet<Integer> source;
        Predicate<Integer> accepted = value -> value != null && value % 2 == 0;
        if (bounded) {
            source = new TreeSet<>(Arrays.asList(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)).subSet(1, true, 4, true);
            if (reverse) source = source.descendingSet();
        } else {
            source = new TreeSet<>(Comparator.nullsFirst(Integer::compare));
            source.addAll(Arrays.asList(null, 1, 2));
        }
        NavigableSet<Integer> oracle = new TreeSet<>(source.comparator());
        for (Integer value : source) if (accepted.test(value)) oracle.add(value);
        NavigableSet<Integer> view = bounded ? M3MutableFilteredViews.filter(source, accepted)
                : id.startsWith("legacy-") ? FilteredViews.navigableSet(source, accepted)
                : M3FilteredViews.filter(source, accepted);
        Integer expected;
        Object observed;
        if (bounded) {
            int key = reverse ? -100 : 100;
            expected = oracle.floor(key);
            try { observed = view.floor(key); }
            catch (RuntimeException failure) { observed = failure.getClass().getName(); }
        } else {
            expected = oracle.ceiling(null);
            try { observed = view.ceiling(null); }
            catch (RuntimeException failure) { observed = failure.getClass().getName(); }
        }
        String signature = "NAVIGATION/JDK_ORACLE_MISMATCH/" + id;
        if (!Objects.equals(expected, observed)) {
            throw new AssertionError(signature + " expected=" + expected + " observed=" + observed);
        }
        System.out.println("RESOLVED " + signature);
    }
}
